messages:
rachel-partners: Heads-up — product marketing wants a joint SI + HW marketplace push next sprint. Need a quick ROE for lead handoffs, account mapping, and kit reservation. Target launch in 10 days.
leo-sales: OK — i'll run a top-100 account sweep and flag active opps. will add poi tags.
arjun-si: request: SI claims accepted only if poi>=2 OR demo booked. prevents cold grabs. Also need a demo intake link.
nina-ops: suggest minimal claim CSV so other teams can ingest: acct_id,acct_name,current_owner,region,stage,si_claim,poi,claim_ts,claim_source.
tom-hw: inventory note — dev kits are limited. will publish sku,qty,lead_time to /shared/hw/alloc.csv by EOD. claims must include qty_needed.
rachel-partners: conflict ladder draft: (1) AE with active forecast, (2) SI with signed NDA/SOW or poi>=3, (3) marketplace-origin leads. escalate ties to @comms-bot.
leo-sales: SLA ask: SI respond to claims within 48h with next-step (demo scheduled / more info). if no response, ownership reverts to AE.
arjun-si: 48h works. we'll also require a one-paragraph integration summary and named SE before claiming production work.
comms-bot: calendar created: "SI-HW intake triage" Thu 9:30am PT — attendees: rachel-partners, leo-sales, arjun-si, nina-ops.
rachel-partners: i'll drop a claims template to /shared/si/claims_template.csv with `expected_phases` (poc,pilot,prod) and `qty_requested`.
tom-hw: noted. will add `sku_reserved_until` column so ops can release unclaimed reservations after 10 business days.
leo-sales: action items: sweep tonight + upload CSV; nina = ingest pipeline mapping; arjun = demo intake + SE rotation; rachel = finalize ROE doc and loop legal if needed.
arjun-si: volunteer to triage collisions tomorrow AM.
comms-bot: reminder set for triage meeting. 
 rachel-partners: thanks all — concise ROE and template should keep the launch clean. :thumbsup:
